content.title: Are consumer staples stocks still worth investing in?
content.description:
Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Brooke DiPalma and Slatestone Wealth chief market strategist Kenny Polcari come on Opening Bid to assess the state of the US consumer and whether the consumer staples (XLP) category still offers investors stability.

Also be sure to catch Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi's full interview with Procter & Gamble (PG) CFO Andre Schulten after the company released fourth quarter earnings results.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Opening Bid.

content.title: CEOs Flag Jittery US Consumers as Global Tensions Intensify
content.summary: Delta Air Lines Inc. said geopolitical uncertainty is clouding its profit outlook, while United Airlines Holdings Inc. warned that global tensions are beginning to hit some travel demand.  Executives at consumer staples companies Procter & Gamble Co. and McCormick & Co. said shoppers remain cautious.

content.title: MKC Q4 Deep Dive: Margin Pressures Offset Modest Sales Growth as Guidance Clouds Outlook
content.summary: Food flavoring company McCormick (NYSE:MKC) reported Q4 CY2025 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 2.9% year on year to $1.85 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.86 per share was 1.8% below analysts’ consensus estimates.
